rationale: The workflow already implements the CI optimizations supported by the retrieved evidence. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is covered by the existing `concurrency` block with `cancel-in-progress: true`, which cancels superseded runs on the same branch/PR. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE is already extensively applied across jobs (Cargo registry, nightly toolchain, cargo-fuzz, Anchor SBF/localnet builds, Yarn artifacts, Trident CLI/harness, nextest host build). P-LIT-FAIL-FAST does not meaningfully apply because the only matrix strategy (`fuzz-trident`) contains a single test item, so `fail-fast` has no remaining jobs to cancel and changing it would be a no-op. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is already present on `localnet-test-marginfi` (`timeout-minutes: 40` with documented rationale); other jobs lack representative successful-duration history to justify new timeouts. Remaining patterns (P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST, P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT, P-LIT-SELECT, etc.) require CI service-level changes or separately approved policies rather than workflow edits. No supported optimization fits without being a no-op, weakening coverage, or requiring unsupported service changes.
